name: transitions
title: Transitions
line: A join between two shots: a punch, whip, crossfade, wipe, glitch, light leak, flash or dots, each landing on its cut with a sound of its own
card: A whip, wipe or flash between two shots
say: add a transition between my clips
zoom punch on my jump cuts

askeditor.what: Put a transition on each join of my video
askeditor.why: each transition stays on its cut: swap the look, move it or change its length without rendering again
